desc: The Nocpix MATE ULTRA combines the world's best production thermal sensor with an integrated laser rangefinder and the compact versatility of a thermal clip-on. Compatible with magnifications up to 12X, the MATE ULTRA can be mounted in front of your existing day optic to provide full thermal detection without re-zeroing or swapping optics. The MATE features an adjustable heads-up display for a clear, detailed sight picture at any magnification, multiple zeroing profiles for consistent point-of-impact retention across multiple rifles, and runs on standard 18650 rechargeable batteries. Whether you're hunting hogs, controlling predators, or running multiple rifle setups, the MATE series is built to perform when the sun goes down.
